rules.requirement: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you kill yourself this way, a Minion becomes the Imp.

assertingTests.name: Imp self-kill passes the role and the new Demon does not act again (TB-IMP-01)
the Imp's attack kills the chosen player and writes the attack's own step record and log line (TB-IMP-01)
Monk protection stops the Imp; a poisoned Monk does not (TB-MONK-01)
the Soldier is safe from the Imp while sober and dies while poisoned (TB-SOLDIER-01)
Mayor redirect to a dead player kills nobody and the Mayor lives (TB-MAYOR-01)
a poisoned Imp cannot kill itself and no new Demon is created (TB-IMP-01, TB-POISONER-01)
an Imp attack on a working Mayor waits for the host's redirect and changes nothing (TB-IMP-01, TB-MAYOR-01)
a redirected Imp attack kills the host's choice and journals the redirect before the attack line (TB-IMP-01, TB-MAYOR-01)
an Imp self-kill passes the role to the only living Minion inside the attack step and queues the new Demon's wake (TB-IMP-01)
an Imp self-kill with several living Minions holds the win check until the host names the heir (TB-IMP-01)
an Imp kill that leaves two players alive ends the game from the attack step (TB-IMP-01)
the Imp attack previews, applies and replays with the command clock and ids (TB-IMP-01)
an Imp attack on a working Mayor is a host choice on the command path and the answer completes it (TB-IMP-01, TB-MAYOR-01)
the Imp attacks the chosen player under its own log title (TB-IMP-01)
an impaired Imp returns the same attack: the shared attack path stops it (TB-IMP-01)
the new Demon's wake is queued as soon as the host names the heir, before the next step (TB-IMP-01)
when the Imp's step was the night's last, the night does not end before the named heir is woken (TB-IMP-01)
a Demon who died on an earlier day does not make a later night change wake twice (TB-IMP-01, TB-SCARLETWOMAN-02)
a named heir an older ruleset left unwoken is woken on the next night by a command sent now (TB-IMP-01)
a journal recorded while the new Demon was woken twice replays and undoes as written (TB-IMP-01, TB-SCARLETWOMAN-02)
a game saved the day after an Imp self-kill by an older ruleset does not wake the new Demon again, and undo replays its journal (TB-IMP-01)
a living Imp's mandatory attack cannot be skipped and the state does not move (TB-IMP-01)
